description_en: Calls DescribeHiTSDBInstance to retrieve the details of an instance
name: DescribeHiTSDBInstance

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details about the access denial
AccessDeniedDetail.description_zh: 访问被拒绝的详细原因

AutoRenew.description_en: Indicates whether auto-renewal is enabled for the subscription instance. For more information about how to enable auto-renewal, see enable auto-renewal
AutoRenew.description_zh: 付费类型为包年包月的实例，是否开通自动续费

ChargeType.description_en:
The billing method. Valid values:
PREPAY: subscription
POSTPAY: pay-as-you-go
ChargeType.description_zh: 付费类型，PREPAY-包年包月；POSTPAY-按量付费

CreateTime.description_en: The timestamp when the instance was created

DiskCategory.description_en:
The disk category for TSDB for InfluxDB® instances. Valid values:
cloud_efficiency: ultra cloud disk
cloud_ssd: standard SSD
DiskCategory.description_zh: 对于TSDB for InfluxDB®️类型，cloud_efficiency-高效云盘，cloud_ssd-SSD云盘

EngineType.description_en:
The engine type. Valid values:
tsdb_tsdb: TSDB
tsdb_influxdb: TSDB for InfluxDB®
tsdb1.5: TSDB 1.5
EngineType.description_zh: 引擎类型，tsdb_tsdb-tsdb类型，tsdb_influxdb-TSDB for InfluxDB®️类型，tsdb1.5-tsdb1.5类型

ExpiredTime.description_en: The timestamp when the subscription instance expires
ExpiredTime.description_zh: 对于包年包月类型，实例过期的时间戳

GmtCreated.description_en: The time when the instance was created. Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
GmtCreated.description_zh: 实例创建时间，格式为yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss

GmtExpire.description_en: The expiration time of the subscription instance. Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
GmtExpire.description_zh: 付费类型为包年包月的实例的到期时间，格式为yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss

InstanceStatus.description_en:
The instance status. Valid values:
ACTIVATION: running
CREATING: being created
NET_CREATING: creating network connection
CLASS_CHANGING: changing instance specifications
LOCKED: locked
DELETED: deleted
InstanceStatus.description_zh:
实例状态，ACTIVATION-运行中，CREATING-创建中，NET_CREATING-创建网络链接中，CLASS_CHANGING-实例变配中
 ，LOCKED-已锁定，DELETED-已删除

InstanceStorage.description_en: The instance storage capacity. Unit: GB
InstanceStorage.description_zh: 实例存储， 单位 G

InstanceTps.description_en: The TPS performance of the instance. Unit: requests per second
InstanceTps.description_zh: 实例 Tps 性能， 单位<请求/秒>

MaxTimelineLimit.description_en: The maximum number of timelines for the instance. This parameter applies to TSDB instances
MaxTimelineLimit.description_zh: 实例时间线性能， 单位<条>，针对TSDB类型实例

MemSize.description_en: The memory size of the database. This parameter applies to TSDB for InfluxDB® instances
MemSize.description_zh: 数据库内存大小，针对TSDB for InfluxDB®️类型实例

NetworkType.description_en: The network type of the instance

PaymentType.description_en:
The billing method. Valid values:
PREPAY: subscription
POSTPAY: pay-as-you-go
PaymentType.description_zh: 付费类型，PREPAY-包年包月；POSTPAY-按量付费

PublicConnectionString.description_en: The public network connection string of the instance

SecurityIpList.description_en: The IP address whitelist of the instance

Ip.description_en: The IP address in the whitelist

Series.description_en:
The edition of the TSDB for InfluxDB® instance. Valid values:
0: Basic Edition
1: High-availability Edition
Series.description_zh: TSDB for InfluxDB®️类型实例的版本，0-基础版，1-高可用版

Status.description_en:
The instance status. Valid values:
ACTIVATION: running
CREATING: being created
NET_CREATING: creating network connection
CLASS_CHANGING: changing instance specifications
LOCKED: locked
DELETED: deleted
Status.description_zh:
实例状态，ACTIVATION-运行中，CREATING-创建中，NET_CREATING-创建网络链接中，CLASS_CHANGING-实例变配中

ZoneId.description_en: The zone ID of the instance
